    int n;
    string str;
    cin >> n >> str;
    str += '^';
    n++;

    char copy[256];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) copy[i] = str[i];
    string buf = (n > 0) ? string(copy, n) : string();

    deque<string> outside;
    deque<string> inside;
    int flag = 0;
    string s;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char c = buf[i];
        if (c == '(') {
            flag = 1;
            buf[i] = '^';
            continue;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            flag = 0;
            inside.push_back(s);
            buf[i] = '^';
            s.clear();
        }
        if (flag == 1) {
            s += buf[i];
            buf[i] = '^';
        }
    }

    s.clear();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (buf[i] == '^') {
            if (!s.empty()) {
                outside.push_back(s);
                s.clear();
            }
        } else {
            s += buf[i];
        }
    }

    int max = 0;
    for (const string& part : outside) {
        string t = part + "_";
        int current = 0;
        for (char c : t) {
            if (isalpha(c)) current++;
            else if (c == '_') {
                if (current > max) max = current;
                current = 0;
            }
        }
    }

    int count = 0;
    for (const string& part : inside) {
        string t = part + "_";
        string word;
        for (char c : t) {
            if (isalpha(c)) word += c;
            else if (c == '_' && !word.empty()) {
                word.clear();
                count++;
            }
        }
    }

    cout << max << " " << count << endl;
    return 0;
}
